title: The runner lost in the Sahara who survived on bats
hook: An Italian runner survived nine days lost in the Sahara by eating bats.
summary: In 1994 Italian runner Mauro Prosperi was lost by a sandstorm during the Marathon des Sables, survived about nine days on bats from a shrine, and was found in Algeria far off course.
sources: Wikipedia / Marathon des Sables: Mauro Prosperi, Italian police officer, lost in a sandstorm in 1994, wandered for about nine days and ended up in Algeria.
BBC and Guardian features on Mauro Prosperi: sheltered in a marabout shrine, ate bats, found by a nomad family, about 300 km off course.

lines.text: An Italian runner survived nine days lost in the Sahara by eating bats.
lines.caps: An Italian *runner | survived *nine days | lost in the *Sahara | by eating *bats.

lines.text: In nineteen ninety-four, Mauro Prosperi entered a desert race in Morocco.
lines.caps: In *1994, | Mauro *Prosperi | entered a desert *race | in *Morocco.

lines.text: Then a sandstorm erased the trail, and he ran the wrong way.
lines.caps: Then a *sandstorm | erased the *trail, | and he ran the *wrong way.

lines.text: His water ran out under the burning sun.
Then he found a small shrine, and bats lived inside.
lines.caps: Then he found a *shrine, | and *bats | lived *inside.

lines.text: He ate them, and that food kept him alive.
lines.caps: He *ate them, | and that *food | kept him *alive.

lines.text: After nine days, a nomad family found him, weak but alive.
lines.caps: After *nine days, | a *nomad family | *found him, | weak but *alive.

lines.text: He had crossed into Algeria, about three hundred kilometres off course.
lines.caps: He was in *Algeria, | about *300 kilometres | off *course.

post.caption:
He was only meant to run for six days. Instead he spent nine days lost in the Sahara.
Would you have eaten the bats to survive?
